department: School of Computing and Data Science — Department of Computer Science

deadline.value: Main Round and Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS) deadline for 2027-28 entry is December 1, 2026 (1st Clearing Round: April 30, 2027; 2nd Clearing Round: August 31, 2027).

also.quote: In view of the limited admission quota, applicants are strongly encouraged to apply in the Main Round. Applications will be considered in the clearing rounds only if there are vacancies after the Main Round.

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for computer science (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: HKU Graduate School treats contacting a potential supervisor before applying as optional.

funding.value: Full-time PhD students with 2:1 honours or above are normally eligible for Postgraduate Scholarships (HK$19,135/month; HK$19,655/month after confirmation, wef 1/9/2026), subject to funding availability, plus HKU-PS/HKPF fellowships.
funding.quote: other full-time PhD and MPhil students who hold a first degree with second-class honours first division (or equivalent) or above are normally considered eligible to receive a Postgraduate Scholarship (PGS) during the normative study period, subject to availability of funding. | The basic level of scholarship is HK$19,135 per month (wef 1/9/2026).

also.quote: Various scholarships, fellowships, and conference/travel support are also available to enrich students’ learning experience and promote professional and personal development

entry_route.quote: The School of CDS offers the following research postgraduate programmes in both full-time and part-time modes: | Master of Philosophy (MPhil) | 3-year Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) | 4-year Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) | Computer Science – Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) and Master of Philosophy (MPhil)

also.quote: All candidates with an honours Bachelor’s degree are eligible for PhD and MPhil admission.

notes: HKU School of Computing and Data Science (CDS, formed July 2024) encompasses Computer Science and Statistics & Actuarial Science and also runs an early recruitment scheme (2026-08-31 for 2027-28 entry) alongside HKU Main Round (2026-12-01).
